blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Monday challenged the camp of Vice President Sara Duterte to show records disproving her alleged connection with China. The challenge stemmed from an allegation by former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV that CALLE88 Foods Corp., a company linked to Mans Carpio, received P319 million from the Chinese government. READ: Palace wants closer look at ‘China money’ linked to VP husband’s firm Trillanes also claimed that the Tapang at Malasakit Alliance for the Philippines Inc., a foundation where Duterte is an incorporator, received a P150-million donation from the Chinese embassy in the Philippines.
